errors.description: counter_snapshot_q is a multi-bit value produced in core_clk and sampled directly in trace_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
sample_pulse_q is a one-cycle core_clk pulse consumed directly in trace_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
sample_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample trace_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in trace_event_o.
trace_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector trace_mode_q before decoding in trace_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
core_rst_n is used as data inside trace_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
bus_snapshot_q combines core_clk payload state with trace_clk status state in bus_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
